title: The Grumpy Old Cat
text: Our neighbor's cat, Whiskers, always seemed grumpy, hissing at anyone who came near. One rainy afternoon, I found Whiskers shivering under our porch, drenched and shaking. I realized she wasn't mean, just frightened and cold. I brought out a warm towel and a bowl of milk. Slowly, Whiskers relaxed and let me dry her fur. From that day on, Whiskers greeted me with a soft, contented purr instead of a hiss.
